description.value:
As a minor action, you can leap and curl into a loop so that you begin rolling on your armored spine. While you are in this wheel form, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC. The only actions you can take while in wheel form are the Dash, Disengage, Saving a Target, and Self-Defense actions, and you can leave wheel form as a minor action or by falling @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.RK3DF56CKMQUV6DM]{Prone}. If you start your turn in wheel form, your walking speed is increased by 10ft until the end of your turn.
While in wheel form, if you roll at least 15ft in a straight line immediately before ramming into a creature, they must make a Dexterity (Save) check versus 8 + your Strength (Athletics) bonus. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage per 15ft you traveled this turn before the collision (max 3d6) and you immediately exit your wheel form.
